2026_01_NYJ_TEN.headline: The Jets’ protection plan will decide whether Tennessee can turn this opener into a pressure game
2026_01_NYJ_TEN.paragraph1: New York opens with Geno Smith back in a Jets uniform and Garrett Wilson still the offense’s clearest matchup winner, while Tennessee is installing new systems around Cam Ward. The Titans’ interior rush can make life difficult if the Jets lose early downs, but New York’s tackles have a chance to hold up on the edges and create time for Wilson to work. Tennessee needs Ward to stay efficient and avoid putting its own defense back on the field after short possessions.
2026_01_NYJ_TEN.model_rationale: New York can control the matchup if its tackles keep the pocket stable and Wilson gets consistent opportunities, while Tennessee needs pressure and efficient quarterback play to prevent sustained Jets drives.
